activation: Wait for user to announce Azure readiness; no Oracle x86 access or automatic launch.
workflow: e2e_one_beam_ownmap: GoalRoute -> OwnRoute -> received S4 approval -> S3 -> own RGB setdown
bundle_rule: Freeze source/config closure and register a new bundle before execution; v179 historical success cannot transfer.
inputs: r1 own RGB GoalRoute/observed grid and own command history; r2 only delivered compact route + own observations; evaluation GT stays outside controls.
endpoint: Observed B boundary only; no authored B fallback or test_route_provider.
no_comm: No B delivery to r2, route approval/claim/transport must remain closed; intentional contract hold is not carry success.

server.admission: total load average <12.8, existing workload + added .6 cores/run <=12.8, MemAvailable >=6GiB after each admission
server.memory_rule: Require >=6 + .4*new_runs GiB before adding a group; reject/wait for memory, preserve paired groups.
server.grouping: Admit each condition/seed baseline+2 candidates together; 6 groups first wave, 2 groups second wave if other work allows.
server.storage: Persistent ~/ugrp-sim/runs only; >=10GiB free plus estimated remaining raw budget (initial reserve 48GiB); ENOSPC=HOST_ERROR

time.provenance: Earlier x86 S3 timing only; Azure unmeasured, not a throughput guarantee
time.recompute: Measure first 180/300 wall seconds before revising completion estimate.

per_run: commands progress through meaningful phases; no endless turns
own map/B proposal and received approval state recorded
initial_health.exception: no_comm expected contract hold must be explicitly recorded
initial_health.on_failure: Stop only the failed run, record EXIT, repair and resubmit with new run identity.

verdict: full beam outline inside B in eval-only output
setdown needs complete own RGB B boundary, revised route approval and new epoch GO/ACK
retention: Evaluate/hash on execution host, archive full originals on ARM after verified transfer; fetch-lite only to Mac; no image/npz/video batch fetch.
physical_readiness_limits: B may be occluded; gate holds, no synthetic boundary
NEES scale does not establish held-out coverage or r1 transfer
Native host composition/registered bundle must consume these opt-in interfaces; legacy authored-map runtime remains rejected.
